svg.title: PR imported on a private branch, merged to private main, then pushed to public in two fast-forward steps
svg.desc: Commits C1 to C7. Public and private main start at C1. A private import branch merges the public PR as C5. A sync branch merges the import branch and resolves conflicts as C6. The sync PR is merged into private main as C7. C5 is pushed to public main as a fast-forward, then C7 is pushed as a second fast-forward.
